acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer requires enable execution with a current bound Candidate identity.

oracle.expected: The real Consumer call surface invokes the Candidate Route and exposes the successful enable execution.
forbidden: Enable is executed only through a simulated or non-real call surface.
oracle.observable: The Consumer invocation record and Candidate Route result produced while the FR-10 selector exercises enable.

acceptance.then: Enable has been executed by the applicable Consumer through its real call surface.
acceptance.when: The FR-10 replay selector exercises the enable transition.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise enable through an applicable real Consumer with the Candidate Route call suppressed; fail when no real Candidate Route invocation is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and require a real applicable-Consumer invocation of the Candidate Route during enable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserves existing Consumer interfaces and route compatibility while adding real-call verification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Applicable Consumer requires enable execution -> applicable Consumer invokes Candidate Route through its real call surface.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each applicable Consumer's enable transition has a real Candidate Route invocation and observable result; simulated or absent calls are rejected.
